description:
This Thursday on VSRF Live, don’t miss a crucial update: White Fibrous Clots on the Rise!Show more We welcome Thomas Haviland, retired U.S. Air Force Major and independent researcher, who has been tracking the alarming and unprecedented phenomenon: white, fibrous clots discovered during embalming over the past several years. We will also hear from a gentleman with direct experience — Wallace P. (Wally) Hooker CFSP, MBIE, the owner/funeral director/embalmer of Family & Friends Funeral Home of Wingate, IN. This week, Mr. Haviland and Mr. Hooker bring a critical update that raises the stakes.
What we’ll cover:
• Urgent new breakthrough: Haviland’s 2024 worldwide embalmer survey shows that 83% of embalmers—now surveying 301 professionals—are still encountering these fibrous clots in approximately 27.5% of bodies(usawatchdog.com (https://usawatchdog.com/white-fibrous-clots-from-cv19-vax-contagious-tom-haviland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)).
• Contagious prion concerns: Emerging data suggests these clots, potentially a misfolded “amyloid” protein, may be infectious, raising serious implications for embalming staff, healthcare providers, blood supplies, and public safety (usawatchdog.com (https://usawatchdog.com/white-fibrous-clots-from-cv19-vax-contagious-tom-haviland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)).
• How Haviland’s findings compare to prior years, and why this update represents a new level of urgency.
• The mechanistic theories—prions, amyloid accumulation, or other pathways—that may explain the formation and transmissibility of these clots.
• The critiques and pushback his work has faced—and his responses.
• What this means for the industry, public health, and the broader conversation about post-mortem observations tied to Covid vaccine rollout.
📅 Watch this Thursday at 7 PM ET — live on Rumble and X.
Bring your questions. Bring your friends.
